note.zh: 基于可扩展局部自注意力机制构建的参数高效视觉骨干网络。

title.en: VideoGen: Generative Modeling of Videos using VQ-VAE and Transformers
title.zh: VideoGen: Generative Modeling of Videos using VQ-VAE and Transformers

note.en: VideoGen, generating video using VQ-VAE representations combined with transformers.
note.zh: VideoGen，结合VQ-VAE表征与Transformer生成视频。

title.en: VideoGPT: Video Generation using VQ-VAE and Transformers
title.zh: VideoGPT: Video Generation using VQ-VAE and Transformers

note.en: VideoGPT scales likelihood-based video generation by combining a VQ-VAE over video with an autoregressive Transformer over the discrete latents.
note.zh: VideoGPT 将视频上的 VQ-VAE 与在离散隐变量上的自回归 Transformer 结合，把基于似然的视频生成扩展到自然视频。

title.en: Reinforcement Learning with Latent Flow
title.zh: Reinforcement Learning with Latent Flow

note.en: Feeds optical-flow-like motion features into the policy so pixel-based RL agents can use temporal information without extra supervision.
note.zh: 将类似光流的运动特征输入策略网络，使基于像素的强化学习智能体无需额外监督即可利用时序信息。

title.en: D2RL: Deep Dense Architectures in Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: D2RL: Deep Dense Architectures in Reinforcement Learning

note.en: D2RL shows that dense skip connections in the actor and critic networks improve deep RL performance across a range of tasks.
note.zh: D2RL 表明，在 actor 与 critic 网络中加入稠密跳连可以在多种任务上提升深度强化学习的表现。

title.en: SUNRISE: A Simple Unified Framework for Ensemble Learning in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: SUNRISE: A Simple Unified Framework for Ensemble Learning in Deep Reinforcement Learning

note.en: SUNRISE unifies ensemble methods for off-policy RL, using ensemble-based weighted Bellman backups and UCB exploration to stabilise training.
note.zh: SUNRISE 统一了 off-policy 强化学习中的集成方法，通过基于集成的加权贝尔曼更新和 UCB 探索来稳定训练。

title.en: Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Data
title.zh: Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Data

note.en: RAD shows that plain image augmentations such as random crop are enough to make pixel-based RL far more sample-efficient, without any auxiliary loss.
note.zh: RAD 表明，仅用随机裁剪等普通图像增强，无需任何辅助损失，就能大幅提升基于像素的强化学习的样本效率。

title.en: CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning

note.en: CURL, his first-author paper adding contrastive representation learning to off-policy RL, one of the standard results for sample-efficient control from pixels.
note.zh: 他作为第一作者的 CURL，将对比表示学习引入 off-policy 强化学习，是像素输入下样本高效控制的代表性成果之一。

title.en: Data-Efficient Image Recognition with Contrastive Predictive Coding
title.zh: Data-Efficient Image Recognition with Contrastive Predictive Coding

note.en: Work at DeepMind scaling Contrastive Predictive Coding so that self-supervised features match supervised accuracy with a fraction of the labels.
note.zh: 在 DeepMind 完成的工作，将对比预测编码扩展到使自监督特征仅用少量标签即可达到监督学习的准确率。

title.en: Flow++: Improving Flow-Based Generative Models with Variational Dequantization and Architecture Design
title.zh: Flow++: Improving Flow-Based Generative Models with Variational Dequantization and Architecture Design

note.en: Flow++ improves flow-based generative models with variational dequantization and a redesigned coupling architecture, closing much of the density-modeling gap.
note.zh: Flow++ 通过变分反量化和重新设计的耦合结构改进基于流的生成模型，大幅缩小了密度建模上的差距。

title.en: Universal Planning Networks
title.zh: Universal Planning Networks

note.en: His first-author Berkeley paper learning a latent space in which gradient-descent planning itself is trained end to end for visuomotor control.
note.zh: 他在伯克利作为第一作者的论文，学习一个隐空间，使梯度下降式的规划过程本身可以端到端训练，用于视觉运动控制。

title.en: Learning to Repeat: Fine Grained Action Repetition for Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Learning to Repeat: Fine Grained Action Repetition for Deep Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Early reinforcement-learning paper he co-authored at IIT Madras, on letting agents decide how long to repeat a chosen action.
note.zh: 他在印度理工马德拉斯分校期间合作的早期强化学习论文，研究让智能体自行决定动作重复的时长。

title.en: Dynamic Frame skip Deep Q Network
title.zh: Dynamic Frame skip Deep Q Network

note.en: Early IIT Madras work letting a DQN agent learn how long to repeat an action rather than using a fixed frame-skip.
note.zh: 他在印度理工马德拉斯分校的早期工作，让 DQN 智能体自行学习动作重复的时长，而非使用固定的跳帧数。

title.en: Option Discovery in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning using Spatio-Temporal Clustering
title.zh: Option Discovery in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning using Spatio-Temporal Clustering

note.en: His first-author early work discovering options in hierarchical RL by spatio-temporal clustering of the agent's state space.
note.zh: 他作为第一作者的早期工作，通过对智能体状态空间做时空聚类，在分层强化学习中自动发现 option。

title.en: Attend, Adapt and Transfer: Attentive Deep Architecture for Adaptive Transfer from multiple sources in the same domain
title.zh: Attend, Adapt and Transfer: Attentive Deep Architecture for Adaptive Transfer from multiple sources in the same domain

note.en: A2T uses an attention mechanism to transfer selectively from multiple source tasks while avoiding negative transfer from unhelpful ones.
note.zh: A2T 利用注意力机制从多个源任务中选择性迁移，同时避免来自无益源任务的负迁移。

title.en: Series E-6 values Perplexity at $22.6B
title.zh: E-6 轮估值 226 亿美元

body.en: On roughly $450–500M annualized revenue. Over 1 billion monthly search queries and 100M+ monthly actives across products.
body.zh: 年化收入约 4.5–5 亿美元。月搜索查询超 10 亿，全产品月活超 1 亿。

title.en: Comet powers Bixby on the Samsung Galaxy S26
title.zh: Comet 为三星 Galaxy S26 的 Bixby 提供支持

body.en: The first OS-level assistant deal for a non-Google engine. Comet hit #3 on the US App Store within 48 hours of its iOS launch and passed 3M monthly actives.
body.zh: 首个非 Google 引擎的操作系统级助手协议。Comet iOS 版上线 48 小时内登上美区 App Store 第 3，月活突破 300 万。

title.en: Srinivas: Perplexity will IPO in 2028 regardless of Anthropic or OpenAI
title.zh: Srinivas：无论 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 如何，Perplexity 都将于 2028 年上市

title.en: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas: People want to use their own local hardware
title.zh: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas: People want to use their own local hardware

body.en: Told CNBC that many users want to run AI on their own local hardware rather than relying on the cloud.
body.zh: 在接受CNBC采访时表示，许多用户希望在自己的本地硬件上运行AI，而非依赖云端。

title.en: 'Up to 20 AI Models at Once': Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas Details Next-Gen AI Vision
title.zh: 'Up to 20 AI Models at Once': Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas Details Next-Gen AI Vision

body.en: Srinivas details his vision for running up to 20 AI models at once, laying out Perplexity's next-generation product direction.
body.zh: Srinivas详细阐述了同时运行多达20个AI模型的构想，勾勒Perplexity下一代产品方向。

title.en: Aravind Srinivas issues stark warning: Multi-billion data centers may soon become obsolete, Perplexity CEO flags 'biggest threat'
title.zh: Aravind Srinivas issues stark warning: Multi-billion data centers may soon become obsolete, Perplexity CEO flags 'biggest threat'

body.en: Srinivas warns that massive data-center buildouts could become obsolete, calling it the industry's biggest looming threat.
body.zh: Srinivas警告称，大规模数据中心建设可能很快过时，并将其称为行业面临的最大潜在威胁。

title.en: ‘The biggest threat to data centres is on-device AI,’ says Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas
title.zh: ‘The biggest threat to data centres is on-device AI,’ says Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas

body.en: Srinivas argued publicly that on-device AI, not competition among data centres, is the bigger long-term threat to the industry's current infrastructure bet.
body.zh: Srinivas公开表示，端侧AI而非数据中心之间的竞争，才是对当前行业基础设施投入的更大长期威胁。
